name: Hungry Penguin 18
author: ZiyadOuamna
description: Rounded teal button that glows on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: On hover, background-color changes from #808080 to #00ffff, box-shadow becomes 0px 0px 15px #00ffff, transform becomes scale(0.9).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Hungry Penguin 18</title>
<style>
/* Hungry Penguin 18 by ZiyadOuamna — https://uiverse.io/ZiyadOuamna/hungry-penguin-18 */
.button {
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 10px 20px;
  border-radius: 15px;
  background-color: gray;
  font-weight: bolder;
  font-size: 25px;
  border: 2px solid black;
  transition: all 0.5s;
}
.button:hover {
  background-color: aqua;
  box-shadow: 0px 0px 15px aqua;

  transform: scale(0.9);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">Button</button>

<footer></footer>

</body>
</html>
